os-denied.cleanup: OsBase watcher cancels only this run prefix, observed owned PendingIntents and channels; passed non-preserveData case removes known owned records/imports and empty root. Failure/unrecognized data retained. Evidence written under acceptance/P9-native-system/<lease>. No OS permission restoration in fixture.
os-denied.protection: Root full default/mobile-v1/keys/original lease baseline before/after; scope cleanup is not a full default-family proof.

os-granted.permissions: Root grants only exact acceptance package after prior state capture; test requires actual canPost. Root restores exact prior permission/app-op state.
os-granted.data: Fresh scoped synthetic events, fixed reading port returns 7, no real Host/P7 ledger; existing app key preserved.
os-granted.cleanup: Same OsBase owned-prefix notification/PendingIntent/channel/known-record cleanup; failure and preserveData retain private material; parent restores permissions.
os-granted.protection: No global cancel, key deletion, app clear, uninstall or old UUID reuse. Full Root originals baseline required.

os-provider.permissions: No permission grant/revoke; installed acceptance provider is required.
os-provider.data: Fresh P9-native-system scoped imports/URIs, no post/playback; existing key preserved.
os-provider.cleanup: OsBase watcher cleanup of exact fresh scopes; retain unrecognized/failure data and lease proof.
os-provider.protection: Only own provider URI/FD/namespace. Cannot prove system UID URI grants or audio audibility.

sound.permissions: No notification permission change, player, recording, grant or post.
sound.data: Test-internal fresh P9-sound-UUID encrypted namespace; existing shared key can be accessed/created by storage. Some cases intentionally persist corrupt/pending bytes.
sound.cleanup: No @After namespace cleanup. Decoder temp files and provider descriptors close/delete in finally/use. Root must inventory exact generated namespace and remove only verified owned leftovers after evidence; never delete shared key or defaults.
sound.protection: Root needs full default/key baseline and bounded parent method deadline; native source has no class Timeout.

ui.permissions: Never clicks enable, permission, system picker, preview or test-notification controls. Optional nativeForeground=1 itself invokes fixed am start via NativeTestForeground and needs Root UI/Activity scheduling.
ui.data: OwnedControlAcceptance P4-owned-control-UUID plus test-specific P9 settings replacement namespace; helper reads selected default records and stops current Activity network/discovery/foreground monitor, sets owned content.
ui.cleanup: @After leaves owned Session foreground, verifies helper selected defaults and no commands. Does not delete owned private data or prove full family inventory. Root must close/reconcile Activity and collect exact roots before own-only cleanup.
ui.protection: Exclusive target Activity/UID lease required; default helper verification is a subset, not full P7/default/original protection.
ui.activityLaunch: createAndroidComposeRule<MainActivity> launches the target Activity automatically; nativeForeground=1 additionally uses fixed UiAutomation am start. Both require Root UI/UID lease.

app-ui.permissions: No notification permission mutation/post; foreground helper activation is optional but resumed Activity is required.
app-ui.data: Recreates real MainActivity, adopts fresh OwnedControlAcceptance Session, sets fixed local draft; reads five original default notification records.
app-ui.cleanup: @After leaves owned foreground, verifies helper defaults/draft/no commands, restores prior adopted Session and compares five default records. Does not delete owned namespace.
app-ui.protection: Exclusive Activity/target UID lease; no current task/unknown instrument operation. These are warm invalid-ticket routes, not SystemUI/cold valid-ticket proof.
app-ui.activityLaunch: createEmptyComposeRule does not launch. setup requires a RESUMED exact MainActivity, then recreates it; Root must already have it active or explicitly authorize nativeForeground=1.

provider-default.permissions: No OS permission mutation or URI grant. Separate runner-APK witness provider checks ungranted access with its real runner UID, not shell UID.
provider-default.data: Reads default NativeSessionStorage sounds/notices and built-in soft.caf; opens private read-only descriptor and runner provider. May initialize ordinary storage/key paths: Root originals gate required.
provider-default.cleanup: Descriptors/cursors closed; scratch names, original sound and notice records compared; no namespace removal or full default/key proof.
provider-default.protection: App+test matching APK installed, runner separate package UID/witness manifest present. No old consumer dependency; do not replace protected default originals.

legacy-inspection.permissions: No grant/revoke or OS notification call.
legacy-inspection.data: Requires exact preexisting legacy cycle root/marker/identity/recovery records and existing AndroidKeyStore key. Pure legacy parser; do not seed missing original material.
legacy-inspection.cleanup: Compares bounded exact physical encrypted files before/after and writes separate evidence. Retains original root/key.
legacy-inspection.protection: Root explicit original-material inspection authority required. Missing/partial/unknown sidecars refuse; no controller/query replay.

cold-os.permissions: Root-owned granted+enabled notification permission; test never mutates it.
cold-os.data: Explicit fresh cold plan, durable original receipt/notification/PendingIntent; separate writer/reader/observer roles and prior lease proofs.
cold-os.cleanup: Role-dependent original material intentionally persists; never treat class-wide run as independent cleanup.
cold-os.protection: Deferred multi-process/cold lifecycle gate. Do not reuse/cancel/force-stop old5570 consumer or turn its evidence into shell-v2 frames.

cold-router.permissions: No OS post/grant in writer/router cases.
cold-router.data: Explicit cold hook lease/case, seeded original records and fresh reader proof; later maintenance relies on completed original lease.
cold-router.cleanup: Original cold records intentionally persist until separate verified release role.
cold-router.protection: Deferred multi-process flow, not standalone permission/sound/settings readiness. Source comment asking parent to stop reader is not authorization to touch old consumers.
